title: Bollywood Star Tiger Shroff Attacked in Mumbai, Gang Claims Responsibility Amidst Broader News Roundup
summary: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff was reportedly shot at in Mumbai, sustaining minor injuries, with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang quickly claiming responsibility and issuing warnings to other actors. This incident headlines a diverse news cycle, including police action against fake news targeting content creator Dhruv Rathee, a tragic temple accident in Madhya Pradesh claiming 15 lives, and a disturbing case of teenagers murdering a friend for material gain. Other notable stories cover celebrity reactions, event management controversies, and a man scammed by an AI character.
article:
**Bollywood Star Tiger Shroff Attacked in Mumbai; Gang Claims Responsibility**

In a shocking incident that sent ripples through Mumbai, Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff was reportedly shot at while returning home from a football match. The attack occurred publicly when three individuals on a motorcycle intercepted his vehicle, opening fire. Shroff, seated in the passenger seat, sustained minor injuries, while his driver was also hit in the hand. The brazen assault unfolded in front of onlookers, some of whom were recording the actor as a fan. While two assailants continuously fired, a third, closest to Shroff, reportedly had his gun jam, potentially averting more severe consequences.

Immediately following the incident, the notorious Lawrence Bishnoi gang claimed responsibility. Gangster Anil Pandit, affiliated with the Lawrence Bishnoi network, released an audio statement asserting that Shroff had been warned previously and this act was a necessary consequence. The statement also carried a chilling warning to other actors, cautioning them against associating or working closely with Salman Khan, implying they could be the next targets.

Police are currently examining CCTV footage and actively searching for the attackers, working to establish the primary motive behind the assault. Actor Karan Mehra, who was playing football with Shroff that evening, recounted the chaos, stating that by the time they reached the scene, only bloodstains were visible. He expressed relief that Shroff was safe but concern for the driver's recovery. Shroff, after receiving treatment at a hospital, met with the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, who strongly condemned the incident, vowing that no gang would be spared. Tiger's father, Jackie Shroff, also confirmed his son's stable condition.

**Dhruv Rathee Urges Police Action Amidst Fake News Controversy**

Content creator Dhruv Rathee has called upon the police to take action against social media personalities Abhi & Niyu, following a recent Twitter spat. The controversy began when Abhi & Niyu allegedly shared a morphed image of Rathee, leading him to publicly call them out.

Subsequently, Noida Police confirmed taking action against two Twitter users for spreading fake news about Dhruv Rathee's alleged arrest. These accounts were accused of attempting to disrupt peace and order by disseminating false information. Rathee appreciated the police's swift response, further urging them to investigate Abhi & Niyu for "doxxing" identities and endangering citizens' safety through fake news. In a separate development, Ravishon criticized Dhruv Rathee for his London protest against the Indian government, questioning his influence among the youth and accusing him of promoting a "regime change" narrative.

**Nakul Dhull Reflects on Bigg Boss Eviction, Hints Against Re-entry**

Following his eviction from Bigg Boss, Nakul Dhull issued his first statement, addressing ongoing discussions about his potential re-entry. Dhull expressed gratitude to the Bigg Boss team for the opportunity, acknowledging his hard work and wishing he could have contributed more to the show. He believes his eviction was not due to an "extreme" situation but rather a collective request from the housemates. His concluding remark, "अब खत्म करो यार इस मुद्दे को। आगे बढ़ो," ("Let's end this issue now. Move on.") suggests he may not be planning to re-enter the Bigg Boss house.

**Comedian Alleges Harassment by "Mumbai Comedy Mafia"**

A female stand-up comedian, known by her YouTube handle "Marmar Nwa," with approximately 18,000 subscribers, has made serious allegations against Abhishek Upmanyu and other comedians. In an Instagram post, she claimed to be followed by the "Mumbai Comedy Mafia" comprising Upmanyu, Ujjwal, and others. Her allegations included phone hacking, surveillance of calls, theft and circulation of private information, and physical stalking even during routine grocery trips. She warned that if anything were to happen to her or her family, these individuals would be responsible. However, many comments on her post expressed skepticism, questioning the motive behind such actions by prominent comedians, given her lack of specific reasoning.

**Influencer Akanksha Chaudhary Alleges Kidnapping, Scam by Event Organizers**

Influencer Akanksha Chaudhary recounted a harrowing experience at an event in Pune, leveling serious allegations against the management company. She claimed she was scammed, not paid for her appearance, and despite her desire to perform for her fans, she was prevented from doing so. Chaudhary described a severe compromise of her safety, stating that she was forcibly put into a car and driven into the event grounds, directly in front of a thin barricade separating her from the audience, without her team present. She described the situation as "literally kidnapped," only stopping when she resorted to physical confrontation. She vowed to take legal action against the company. The very next day, Chaudhary claimed another similar blunder occurred at a different Pune event, where she was again scammed and denied performance.

**Tragedy Strikes Madhya Pradesh Temple as Truck Plows Through Devotees**

A horrific incident unfolded at a temple in Madhya Pradesh when an out-of-control truck rammed into the premises, killing 15 devotees and injuring nearly 30 others. The tragedy occurred around 1:30 AM when thousands of devotees were present. The truck, traveling downhill, entered a "no entry" zone and only stopped after hitting the temple wall with immense speed. The truck driver fled the scene immediately after the accident and is currently being sought by police. Authorities are investigating how the truck entered the restricted zone despite the large crowd. A police officer suggested the driver, possibly from outside the area, might have used Google Maps for a shorter route, and a probable brake failure led to the loss of control and the devastating accident.

**Global News Briefs: From Celebrity Reactions to Digital Scams**

In other news, Junior NTR fans in the UK faced widespread criticism for organizing a disruptive celebratory march through city streets, drawing condemnation on social media for causing public nuisance and potentially fueling anti-Indian sentiment. Bollywood actor Saif Ali Khan humorously reacted to his viral KBC "ghee" meme, joking on "The Kapil Sharma Show" that he has yet to receive the promised two years of unlimited ghee supply or even a check.

Prabhas's upcoming movie "Spirit" has been postponed from March 2027 to October 29, 2027, setting up a major box office clash with "Ramayan Part 2," which is scheduled for release around the same Diwali period.

A disturbing video from Ecuador showed a priest dying instantly when a giant cross, hanging behind him, fell directly onto his head during a live-streamed mass. The incident sparked discussions about the importance of structural maintenance in old religious buildings.

In a shocking crime, two teenagers in India murdered their friend for a gold chain, a motorcycle, and to fund a birthday celebration. The victim's parents reported him missing, and police investigation, initially misled by a friend's false testimony, uncovered the heinous plot. The teenagers lured their friend to a secluded area under the pretext of smoking, killed him, burned his body with petrol to destroy evidence, and threw his phone from a bus, reminiscent of the "Drishyam" movie plot. Their elaborate plan, however, unraveled due to CCTV and technical investigations.

Finally, a drunk female US tourist created chaos on Indian roads, behaving erratically when locals attempted to help her. In a case highlighting the dangers of online deception, a Brazilian man, struggling with loneliness, sold all his belongings and traveled 1,900 kilometers after an AI character on Instagram promised him a new life and financial support. Upon arrival, he discovered the profile was AI-generated, and the person running the account admitted it was for engagement and sales, expressing surprise at the man's actions.
